study: S2 controlled interactions and S3 three-seed CPU comparison
hypervolume_policy: configured trials plus fixed anchor (1,1); discard points outside reference box; exclude Stored and references
finalists: union of per-study speed, size and compromise roles frozen on training before validation; include production/reference controls and prior synthetic winners as regression sentinels
memory_cases: largest real validation file and largest synthetic validation case, selected by size before measuring
memory_scope: single encode process peak RSS including input/output/runtime and file I/O, excluding decoders and timing loops; separate from encode timings
promotion: none; real holdout was previously visible and is regression evidence
gpu_decision: bound the gain available from measured CPU proposal/feedback overhead; do not infer a trained GPU surrogate result
